title: When Should an AI Abstain Rather Than Answer?
topic: When should a language model decline, defer, or qualify an answer?
brief: This is an OpenAI-only run used to exercise the editorial pipeline while still generating real disagreement. Keep it concrete, accessible, and lively.

participants.name: OpenAI-Pragmatist
participants.stance: Pragmatic about usefulness. Hesitant to abstain if a careful partial answer would still help.

participants.name: OpenAI-Skeptic
participants.stance: Protective of trust. Quick to argue that overconfident answers do more damage than brief refusals.

participants.name: OpenAI-Synthesist
participants.stance: Looks for policy-level balance, edge cases, and user-context nuance.

editorial_goals: Make the disagreement obvious in the first turn.
Use practical examples, not just abstractions.
Keep the prose energetic and readable.
